**Finding: deviation (high severity) — Section 4.2 Termination Payment**

The agreement contains a customer-payable liquidated termination amount: under §4.2(a), if we terminate, we pay HDI 50% of trailing twelve-month Net Sales above $800,000. Measured against our fee obligation (30% of monthly Net Sales above $11,000 under §3.1), that sum can exceed a full year of fees and, given the 90-day notice term structure in §4.1, can exceed the remaining contract value. It also bites on any termination by us — including termination for HDI's breach — with no carve-out.

Redline (validated, fallback position, consistent with precedent seed-ld): the Termination Payment is capped at the fees payable for the three calendar months preceding the Termination Date, applies only to termination for convenience (not for HDI's breach or failure to launch under §1.6), and is the sole amount payable on termination. §4.2(b)–(c) continue to operate against the capped figure.
